easy.question: When the sun climbs up into the sky, it is ______ time.
easy.explanation: The sun rises in the morning.

easy.question: When the moon and stars appear in the sky, it is ______ time.
easy.explanation: We see the moon and stars at night.

easy.question: When the sun is right above our heads, it is ______ time.
easy.explanation: The sun is highest during the afternoon.

easy.question: When the sun dips low and the sky turns orange, it is ______ time.
easy.explanation: The sun sets during the evening, painting the sky orange.

medium.question: List the four parts of a day in order from first to last.
medium.explanation: A day begins with morning, then afternoon, then evening, and ends with night.

medium.question: Name three things you usually do in the morning before leaving for school.
medium.answer: Wake up, brush teeth, take a bath, eat breakfast, and get dressed (any three).
medium.explanation: Morning is when we prepare for the day ahead.

medium.question: When do most people eat their lunch?
medium.explanation: Lunch is the meal we eat during the afternoon.

hard.question: Match each activity with the correct time of day: (a) Eat dinner (b) Leave for school (c) Go to sleep (d) Play outside with friends.
hard.answer: (a) Eat dinner — Night, (b) Leave for school — Morning, (c) Go to sleep — Night, (d) Play outside — Evening.
hard.explanation: Different activities happen at different times of the day.

easy.question: Which takes LONGER: eating a meal or washing your hands?
easy.explanation: Eating a full meal takes many minutes, while washing hands is much quicker.

easy.question: Which finishes FASTER: drinking a glass of water or taking a bath?
easy.explanation: Drinking water takes just a few seconds. Taking a bath takes much longer.

easy.question: Sleeping through the night takes ______ than combing your hair. (longer / shorter)
easy.explanation: Sleeping lasts many hours, but combing hair takes only a minute or two.

medium.question: Arrange from quickest to longest: sleeping at night, combing your hair, eating lunch.
medium.answer: Combing your hair, eating lunch, sleeping at night.
medium.explanation: Combing takes a minute, eating takes about 20 minutes, sleeping takes many hours.

medium.question: Which activity takes the LONGEST time in a day?
medium.explanation: Travelling to school takes much more time than any of the other quick tasks.

hard.question: Give one example of something that takes a short time and one that takes a long time from your daily routine.
hard.answer: Short time: brushing teeth. Long time: being at school (or sleeping at night).
hard.explanation: Some activities last only seconds or minutes, while others take hours.

easy.question: In which season do we enjoy mangoes and watermelons?
easy.explanation: Mangoes and watermelons are summer fruits.

easy.question: In winter, we wear ______ to stay warm.
easy.explanation: Sweaters, jackets, and caps keep us warm in winter.

easy.question: Which season brings lots of rain?
easy.explanation: The monsoon is the rainy season when dark clouds pour water on the land.

easy.question: In which season do flowers bloom on trees?
easy.explanation: Spring is the pleasant season when flowers bloom and butterflies appear.

medium.question: What do we carry with us during the monsoon season?
medium.answer: We carry umbrellas (chhata) and wear raincoats to stay dry.
medium.explanation: It rains heavily during monsoon, so we need protection from the rain.

medium.question: Name all four seasons of India.
medium.answer: Summer, Monsoon (rainy season), Winter, and Spring.
medium.explanation: India experiences four seasons with different weather patterns.

hard.question: Match each season with what we wear: (a) Summer (b) Winter (c) Monsoon. Choices: sweater, light cotton clothes, raincoat.
hard.answer: (a) Summer — light cotton clothes, (b) Winter — sweater, (c) Monsoon — raincoat.
hard.explanation: We choose our clothes based on the weather each season brings.

hard.question: Which festival comes during spring? What do people do during it?
hard.answer: Holi comes in spring. People play with colours, dance, sing, and share sweets.
hard.explanation: Holi is the festival of colours, celebrated when the world is already blooming with colour in spring.
